about: Inventory of represented feature families in Phaser 4.2.1. aliases are search vocabulary, not a list of SDK exports. nativeFacility lists only the native-api source claims; native-boundary anchors explain implementation limits and do not recommend calling private methods. Workflow rows have no nativeFacility: their SDK anchors identify boundaries used by application/tool workflows. pluginFacilities and platformFacilities have separate ownership. Extension/custom-work decisions are requirements judgments, not promises made by the SDK. Source/reference inspection is distinct from native execution, full reference-contract review and live routing.

Phaser best-practices reference

families.extensionSeam: Compose native scenes and a global plugin around game rules.

families.versionLimits: Scene and registry ownership can support restartable games; HEADLESS disables rendering, and does not make browser-dependent subsystems into a Node-only deterministic simulation.
